provenance_meta.study_region: Singhbhum Granite Batholith (East of the Iron Ore Group)

scientific_justification: Archean Singhbhum Granite Batholith (Phases II & III) is a massive composite plutonic basement body (~3.3 to 3.1 Ga) completely devoid of Banded Iron Formation (BIF), Banded Hematite Jasper (BHJ), or sedimentary iron measures.
Background sectors are geographically situated 15 km to 35 km east of the Iron Ore Group Horse-Shoe Synclinorium, avoiding contact metamorphism zones or mineralized shear lineaments.
All background pixels were confirmed cloud-free and valid via Sentinel-2 Scene Classification Layer (SCL classes 4 vegetation and 5 bare ground).

CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC INTEGRITY STATEMENT: Background locations represent remote-sensing pseudo-absences sampled from unmineralized granitic and alluvial terrain; they must NOT be represented as confirmed barren diamond drill holes.
